items.title: Stock picks of the week: 4 stocks with consistent score improvement and upside potential of up to 28%
items.description: There are two factors that the Indian markets will have to deal with in the coming days. The first, of course, is the reignited US-Iran war (or failed ceasefire). If it continues, and oil inches higher and remains elevated, things might change. Then there is the second factor. Our selected stocks for today depict a strong upward trajectory in their overall average score which is based on five key pillars: Earnings, fundamentals, relative valuation, risk, and price momentum. This implies that there has been a significant improvement in their market outlook in the given time frame.

items.title: BSE, Sona BLW among 10 midcap stocks that rose up to 53% in 2026. Do you own any?
items.description: After a sharp correction earlier this year, the outlook is turning more constructive for the midcap and smallcap stocks. While largecaps should continue to remain the anchor of portfolios due to relatively better valuations and downside protection, the incremental allocation case has shifted towards select small and midcap stocks as earnings breadth improves, return on equity converges, and reflation provides support. Here are the top 10 midcaps stocks YTD.

items.title: NIfty IT logs best weekly gains since Oct 2025
items.description: Indian IT stocks experienced a significant rebound this week.  The Nifty IT index saw its best weekly gain since October 2025.  This rally followed a sell-off in Asian AI and semiconductor stocks.  First-quarter earnings from major IT firms showed minimal AI disruption.  Investor confidence improved, leading to some short-covering in the sector.

items.title: D-Street bucks Asian markets' meltdown
items.description: The NSE’s Nifty 50 rose 261.55 points, or 1.1%, to close at 24,334.3, while the BSE Sensex gained 964.58 points, or 1.25%, to end at 78,151.45.

items.title: Concurrent Gainers: 13 smallcap stocks that gain for 5 days in a row
items.description: Over the five trading sessions ending July 17, the Sensex benchmark advanced 0.75%, or 582 points, to close at 78,151, posting gains in four of the five sessions. Despite the benchmark's modest gain over the period, 17 stocks from the BSE SmallCap index advanced in each of the five consecutive sessions between July 13 and 17. Among these, 13 stocks delivered cumulative returns ranging from 10% to 15% during the period. (Data Source: ACE Equity)

items.title: FIIs, retail raise stakes in Q1; 12 stocks rally up to 135%, 5 turn multibaggers
items.description: For retail investors, tracking stocks where Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) are increasing exposure can provide valuable market cues, as FIIs typically invest after extensive research and strong conviction. The June 2026 quarter (Q1FY27) shareholding disclosures are currently underway.Based on the data announced so far, an ETMarkets analysis identified around 492 stocks with a market capitalisation of over Rs 3,000 crore where both FIIs and retail investors hold stakes.Of these, 88 stocks saw an increase in holdings by both FIIs and retail investors (individual shareholders with nominal share capital of up to Rs 2 lakh) in the June 2026 quarter compared with the previous quarter.Around 60 stocks from this list delivered positive returns over the past six months. ETMarkets highlighted 12 stocks that rallied 75-135% during this period, including five multibaggers, where both FIIs and retail investors raised their stakes in the June quarter. (Data Source: ACE Equity)
